name: infinite-moving-cards
title: Infinite Moving Cards
blurb: Cards scroll continuously in a seamless loop, pausing on hover.
description: Clones items to create an infinite scrolling marquee of cards with quote, name, and title fields. Configurable direction and speed; mask gradients fade edges.
use_when: Displaying testimonials, reviews, or social proof in an eye-catching, continuously-cycling format.
avoid_when: Motion-sensitive users—animation runs constantly and has no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
a11y: Cards are read-only; no keyboard navigation. Animation pauses on hover. No ARIA labels for the loop or motion semantics.
